Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a redesigned transparent game card illustration for BALANCE (均衡), WizardCard. Requested 1024x768 landscape RGBA PNG.

Straight regular triangular sides, unmistakable six-point star silhouette. The star floats alone on true alpha transparency. Flat exact frontal view, no perspective, no tilt.
Fantasy pixel art with intentional hard square pixel clusters, broad clearly stepped edges, rich yet restrained old-brass narrow bands, teal engraved channels, six identical small teal rhombus inlays repeated equally at the six points. Tasteful over-under intersections and tiny matching angular notches in the metal bands give a designed arcane artifact quality. The motif and all ornaments are balanced with sixfold rotational symmetry, left/right mirror symmetry, symmetrical flat emissive lighting. EMPTY TRANSPARENT spaces inside all triangular apertures and central hexagon. No central crystal and no extra circular rings. Keep thin airy triangle construction and a strong readable star, never a solid filled polygon. Centered, large enough to read, subject about68 percent of image width, completely inside frame with generous transparent margin.
Palette limited in appearance to old brass #6D5035 #9B7448 #C49A5A #E0BE7C #F2DBA0, teal #174A4B #247475 #3CA6A0 #72D7C5 #B6F0DD, dark outline #101320. Pixel illustration, no soft gradient, no 3D rendered smoothness, no blur, no glowing haze outside the exact silhouette.
ABSOLUTELY NO BACKGROUND: alpha0 everywhere outside the star and through its openings; NOT a black background, NOT white, NOT solid color, NOT a painted transparency checkerboard. No scene, room, plinth, altar, floor, cast shadow, backdrop, vignette or surrounding particles. Opaque metal subject, transparent empty space. No text, letters, numbers, caption, frame or watermark.
